principle_violations.reason: The CreditPaymentProcessor violates the Interface Segregation Principle because it is forced to implement the auth_sms method, which is not required for credit payments.
principle_violations.suggestion: Separate the authentication logic into another interface or class so that DebitPaymentProcessor can use it independently without forcing CreditPaymentProcessor to implement it.
